title: ifl.event Body Schema
description: Body schema for ifl.* command topics. Carries a device or service event from an IFL adapter routed through Bridge. Pattern topic: ifl.{category}.{adapter}.{event}.

adapter_id.description: IFL adapter identifier (e.g. fitbit, hue, nest, tesla).

category.description: Device category from IFL adapter registry.

event_type.description: Adapter-specific event type (e.g. heart_rate, brightness, lock_state).

device_id.description: Physical device identifier from IFL device registry.

payload.description: Adapter-specific event payload. Schema varies per adapter and event_type.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the device event (device-reported time).

adapter_signature.description: HMAC signature from the IFL adapter proving event authenticity.

location.description: Device location within household (e.g. living_room, bedroom).

firmware_version.description: Device firmware version for compatibility tracking.
